description.en: A-share (沪深) monitoring plugin: real-time tickers via pytdx, K-line charts (klinecharts), holdings tracker with stop-loss / take-profit alerts, four screener strategies (institutional, breakout, trend, speculative), and AI-conversational queries via four stock_* tools. Auto-starts a Python backend on plugin load (no manual launch). Read-only — no auto-trading, no broker account access, no funds.
description.zh: A 股（沪深）监控插件：通过 pytdx 提供实时行情、klinecharts 提供专业 K线图、持仓监控与止止止损预警、四种选股策略（机构抱团 / 启动股 / 均线多头 / 题材妖股），以及四个 stock_* 工具支持 AI 对话式查询。插件加载时自动启动 Python 后端（无需用户手动）。严格只读——不做自动交易、不接入券商账户、不读取资金。
